_note: Drives Sadie's intent collection across industries. Per vertical: youtube_queries (official Data API; --comments = prospect-level), keywords (filter comments/RSS/social to the actual pain), alert_phrases (→ Google News RSS auto + set as Google Alerts and paste feed URLs into rss_feeds). OPTIONAL per vertical: bluesky_queries (defaults to youtube_queries; needs runtime/.bluesky.env login), mastodon_tags (+ mastodon_instance), yelp_term/yelp_location (needs runtime/.yelp.env), rss_feeds (Google Alerts + forum feeds). Each vertical → its own 'Intent — <vertical>' Instantly campaign. Add verticals freely. Landscaping shows every optional field; the rest inherit the no-config defaults (YouTube comments + Google News + Bluesky).
